column1: # Graded cases for harness/test-recall-runner.sh (bead tla-wekw).
# One row per answer submitted against a rep in REPS.tsv beside this file.
# Tab-delimited, literal first field CASE. Six fields, in order:
#   1  marker    the literal CASE
#   2  id        stable
#   3  rep       a REP id in REPS.tsv
#   4  grade     correct | incorrect | parse-error | other
#   5  rc        the exit code harness/verdict.sh returns on this answer
#   6  answer    the TLA+ submitted
# FIELD 5 IS A MEASURED NUMBER, NOT A PREFERENCE. Each row was run on TLC2
# 2026.07.31.184830 on 2026-10-16. The suite asserts the raw code and not only
# the grade, so a TLC that renumbered ASSUMPTION_FAILED breaks the build
# instead of quietly relabeling itself. That is the same reason
# harness/test-verdict.sh pins numbers rather than tokens.
# C001 to C004 are the epic's four measured rows. C005 and C006 are the
# non-set rep, where Cardinality errors and the count is skipped. C007 never
# parses, which has to report as its own thing: telling somebody their answer
# is wrong when nothing was graded is a false statement about a check that did
# not run.
